name: Article 2 – § 1 – point 2; Article 19a – 39
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (b a) the following paragraph 4a is inserted: ‘4a. The reporting obligations set out in this Article are without prejudice to Directive (EU) 2016/943 of the European Parliament and of the Council. Therefore, undertakings shall not be required to disclose information on intellectual capital, intellectual property or know-how, business information or technological information which constitutes trade secrets as defined in Article 2, point (1), of Directive (EU) 2016/943.’;
